current_hypothesis: A PPO-trained controller may learn sequential operator-selection decisions for LLM-agent evolution from population state and real execution feedback, and transfer to held-out task families.

blockers: A/B checkers do not compare actual answers with gold; Family C validates keys but not values.
80 sampled states conflicts with Phase 1 minimum of 100; amendment rationale is inaccurate.
PC1 immediate reward estimate omits validity and population-mean reward terms/clipping used by Q.
Cache and seed behavior do not support independent Monte Carlo replicates and the declared CRN design.
Python built-in hash(task_id) makes evolution seed process-dependent.
Train/validation template IDs are identical metadata labels, not distinct generation templates.
Diversity features compute Jaccard similarity rather than the registered Jaccard distance.
PC1 slot arithmetic omits initial population evaluations and mixes planned slots with actual CTX.

current_task: Phase 2A-R1: fix evaluator correctness, template split, feature semantics, stable RNG, PC1 replicate/cache/CRN semantics, reward identity, and cost amendment; then request second independent review.
p0_1_conditions: C1: do not copy GLEET code; independent implementation only.
C2: choose exactly one decision family; M1 selected, M2 frozen.
C3: bandit and FM-rewrite baselines mandatory in effectiveness experiments.
C4: deeper literature collision check before publication-level novelty claims.
C5: if PPO fails to beat contextual bandits on held-out task families, STOP the scoped hypothesis.
phase1_gates: PC1: no PPO training before the myopia diagnostic passes under an approved, budget-consistent protocol.
SR1: if myopia diagnostic fails or remains inconclusive at the hard cap, STOP the PPO hypothesis.
SR2: if PPO does not beat identical-state LinUCB and neural contextual bandit on Family C, STOP.
SR3: if fitness-only state matches full ECOS, revise or stop the execution-feedback claim.
SR4: genotype/operator causality must pass after at most one operator-library revision.
SR5: if cost smoke is infeasible after one scale revision, STOP.
acceptance_rules: Real task correctness, not strategy-keyword checks, must ground the primary metric.
No PC1 execution or controller training before the second independent review approves the corrected protocol.
Use disjoint train/validation templates and hash-frozen manifests; do not execute Family C during development.
Compare PPO against fixed, random, adaptive, contextual-bandit, FM-rewrite, and Q-learning baselines.
Limited-budget allocation is not the central contribution.
No GLEET code reuse and no cross-project artifacts.
